scope: Analyst visual inspection of 36 existing chart PNGs: first indexed example of every observed rule/verdict pair. Notes use linked records for predicates omitted from the overview. No new replay or outcome selection.

branch_notes.GB-FAIL:prior_week_level:comparison-v1: Audit every required prior weekday and native contract. Missing references and 34 fully searched zero-opportunity jobs are different populations; do not interpret missing searches as failed reclaims.
branch_notes.GB-FAIL:prior_month_level:comparison-v1: Only 23 complete jobs and 11 observed opportunities; none of its 55 reporting groups has a complete population. Calendar and contract continuity across the entire reference month dominate the limitation; this branch is too sparse for a ranking claim.
branch_notes.GB-FAIL:cash_open_reclaim_case:compariso: All 161 declared jobs completed; 19 contain no initial opportunity. Useful as a control for coverage accounting. A comparison pass does not establish private cash-open selection or profitability.
branch_notes.GB-FAIL:mss_fvg_refinement:comparison-v1: All 99 child opportunities link one-to-one to the 99 passing NYAM parents and start at parent completion. Keep this conditional denominator separate from initial sweeps. The minute overview does not display the three required 2-minute candles or wick gap.
branch_notes.GB-VWAP:source_long:comparison-v1: 91 missing search jobs and eight observed unknowns from unavailable pre-bar VWAP snapshots are separate gaps. Recover finished Asia/London references and the whole VWAP prefix. A later VWAP touch may occur below the initial breakout price.
branch_notes.SIRES:vwap_deviation_fade:comparison-v1: 102 missing search jobs depend on the overnight prefix. Ten unknown records arise from six trigger bars touching both deviation bands: four bars contribute both sides and two contribute one remaining side. Finer chronology would require a separately specified rule, not automatic relabeling.
branch_notes.SAINT-AMT:continuation_retest:comparison: 54 prior RTH reference gaps shared with GB prior-day. The first later retest determines the result even if later price would tell a different story; no failed retest is repaired by selecting another one.
branch_notes.SAINT-AMT:trapped_buyers_retest:comparis: All four jobs lack required verified inputs; observed zero is not a completed empty population. Prior range plus current executed delta both matter. Investigate 2022 and 2026 reconciliation first.
branch_notes.SAINT-AMT:failed_auction_return:comparis: All four jobs lack verified prior trade-volume context/current tape. Recover the same-contract prior profile and declared current session before evaluating the excursion/return sequence.
branch_notes.SAINT-AMT:poc_traversal:comparison-v1: All four jobs lack verified prior trade-volume context/current tape. Recover the prior POC and range; do not substitute a bar-volume or TPO profile.
branch_notes.KEANI-OPEN-ABOVE-VALUE:source_long:compa: All four clock-based opening observations exist, but every prior profile is unverified: N=4, n=0, u=4. Status measured describes the opening population, not a resolved classification or a validated long entry.
